description: This script generates and tests various CRL (Certificate Revocation List) data structures, including creating certificates, signing CRLs, and testing different invalid and edge case scenarios for CRL parsing and validation.

methods.name: DictUnion
methods.description: Merges two dictionaries, combining their items.

methods.name: Der2Ascii
methods.description: Converts DER-encoded data to ASCII using der2ascii tool.

methods.name: Ascii2Der
methods.description: Converts ASCII data to DER format using ascii2der tool.

methods.name: Ascii2OpensslDer
methods.description: Converts ASCII to DER and formats as OpenSSL DER string.

methods.name: CreateCert
methods.description: Creates an X.509 certificate with specified parameters.

methods.name: SignAsciiCRL
methods.description: Signs a CRL with given TBS inner text and signer.

methods.name: MakePemBlock
methods.description: Encodes DER data into PEM format with headers.

methods.name: WriteStringToFile
methods.description: Writes string data to a specified file path.

methods.name: Store
methods.description: Stores CRL and certificate data into a PEM file with metadata.
